title: फ्लाइट क्यों महँगी — ₹10,000 तक सरचार्ज (IndiGo, 6 Oct 2026)

html.role: the whole film — one deterministic HTML, every frame a pure function of t
html.rights_note: all graphics drawn in code; no photographs, no airline logos

master.role: audio master (narration + 6 distinct cut SFX + bed), loudnorm'd to I -14 / TP -1.5 / LRA 2.4
master.rights_note: narration is our own TTS (voice-03); bed and SFX synthesised from scratch in numpy

timeline.role: measured narration times that drive scene windows

engine.role: camera, grade stack, the 24 official-named transitions

C1.statement: IndiGo fuel surcharge on domestic routes: five distance tiers from Rs 375 to Rs 1,300 per sector
C1.qualification: IndiGo only, on new bookings from 00:01 on 6 Oct 2026

C2.statement: International fuel surcharge range Rs 1,000 to Rs 10,000
C2.qualification: IndiGo, new bookings, headline 'up to Rs 10,000' is the international ceiling

C3.statement: SAARC Rs 1,000 (up to 500 km) and Rs 3,000 (beyond); South-East Asia / GCC / Middle East / N&E Asia Rs 5,500

C4.statement: Europe is the top international tier: Rs 10,000
C4.qualification: Africa's Rs 6,000 figure is omitted because sources disagree on how it is described

C5.statement: ATF price ladder: June Rs 115/l, July Rs 110, August Rs 115, 1 Sep Rs 121, 1 Oct Rs 137
C5.unit: INR per litre for domestic airlines
C5.qualification: single-source series (New Indian Express) — shown on screen with its own tag

C6.statement: ATF price rise of more than 14 per cent month-on-month

C7.statement: Fuel is 35-40 per cent of an airline's operating cost
C7.qualification: industry figure quoted in the same reports (NIE 'up to 40%')

C8.statement: Brent crude at about USD 101.31 a barrel on 5 October 2026

C9.statement: Brent touched USD 115.73 during the escalation phase earlier in the war
C9.qualification: earlier peak, not the current price

C10.statement: The West Asia conflict began on 28 February 2026 with US and Israeli strikes on targets in Iran
C10.qualification: still ongoing at the time of the film

C11.statement: India imports more than 88 per cent of its crude oil
C11.qualification: structural figure, unchanged by the surcharge

C12.statement: March 2026 precedent: Air India, IndiGo and Akasa introduced surcharges in March and cut them around July as prices stabilised
C12.qualification: second round since February; Akasa's March tiers were Rs 199-1,300

C13.statement: As of 5 October 2026 only IndiGo had announced this round; Air India declined to comment
C13.qualification: the March pattern suggests others may follow, which the film states as precedent, not fact

C14.statement: IndiGo carries nearly two-thirds of India's domestic air traffic
C14.qualification: why this single airline's move touches most flyers

shots.purpose: hook: the surcharge is live as of this morning and spans Rs 375 to Rs 10,000
shots.hero: the range itself, counting up under a climbing plane
shots.start_state: night-sky gradient with brand block and kicker
shots.end_state: plane hovering low-right, counters parked at Rs 375 / Rs 10,000, 'new bookings only' chip live
shots.primary_motion: plane climbs from bottom-left on an eased path with a blinking beacon
shots.secondary_motion: fuel droplets fall and fade; amber/blue sparks drift; 70 cabin motes; grid drift
shots.camera: slow breathing zoom 1.006-1.012 with a 16-21 s orbit
shots.audio: distant cabin air bed; entry whoosh at 5.6 s; five fuel-drip blips 8.2-12.6 s; VO1 from 0.55 s
shots.acceptance: both rupee figures legible at full size, no collision with the plane, caption inside its plate
detail_choices: counters tick up with an ease so the eye can read the final number
plane path ends clear of the counter block
rupee amounts use Archivo tabular figures; Hindi uses Noto Devanagari

shots.purpose: the five domestic tiers and the three international tiers
shots.hero: five distance bars growing from the left
shots.end_state: all five bars parked with their rupee values plus three international chips
shots.primary_motion: bars wipe in one per 1.5 s with counting rupee labels
shots.secondary_motion: tick bed, drifting sparks, slow camera drift
shots.camera: breathing zoom with a slow orbit
shots.audio: quiet 0.5 s tick bed under the scale; VO2 from 21.75 s
shots.acceptance: every tier pair (distance + rupee) readable; no bar crosses the rupee column
detail_choices: bars scale with the rupee value so distance and price read as one idea
the top tier is highlighted gold as the ceiling

shots.purpose: the cause: the ATF ladder and the 14 per cent month-on-month jump
shots.hero: a five-step staircase of kerosene prices
shots.end_state: bars parked, +14 per cent stamp landed, decade-high ribbon and the 35-40 per cent gauge visible
shots.primary_motion: bars spring up one per 1.5 s; the +14 per cent stamp lands with a spring
shots.transition: White Flash 0.40 s (softened wrapper, veil peaks at 72 per cent)
shots.acceptance: the one down month is coloured differently; source tag for the single-source ladder is on screen
detail_choices: July prints green because it is the only fall in the series
the single-source ladder carries its own on-screen source tag

shots.purpose: the root: West Asia war, Hormuz, and Brent back over 100 dollars
shots.hero: the Hormuz chokepoint with a tanker threading it
shots.start_state: title 'the root: the West Asia war'
shots.end_state: chips parked, Brent sparkline drawn to its 101-dollar dot on the 100-dollar line
shots.primary_motion: tanker sails the strait on a 8.5 s traverse; sparkline draws left to right
shots.secondary_motion: war rumble bed, two distant horns, drifting sparks
shots.audio: low rumble 73.9-82.9 s, horns at 76.6/80.8 s, rising sweep and a small ding at the 100-dollar crossing; VO4 from 74.514 s
shots.acceptance: the 100-dollar line and the current-price dot are both visible; the map reads as a strait, not a blob
detail_choices: an abstract two-mass landform with a neck, no real map tile
the dashed 100-dollar line makes 'back over 100' checkable in one glance

shots.purpose: what it means for a real ticket
shots.hero: four route cards with distance and surcharge
shots.start_state: title 'what it means for your pocket'
shots.end_state: four cards parked plus the festive-season warning panel
shots.primary_motion: cards slide in one per 2 s with a route motif and a travelling plane glyph
shots.secondary_motion: card swooshes, festive bell, spark drift
shots.audio: four swooshes, bell at the festive chip; VO5 from 100.713 s
shots.acceptance: all four route pairs readable; distances marked approximate on screen
detail_choices: Jammu-Delhi is the first card (local relevance), Delhi-London the international anchor
the distance is drawn ASCII-free, in numerals next to the route pair

shots.purpose: the honest part - what the reports do not say
shots.end_state: four cards parked with the closing line about the surcharge coming off if fuel cools
shots.primary_motion: cards land one per 7.6 s with a motif each (toggle, falling arrow, quote, dots)
shots.secondary_motion: UI ticks, toggle click, a downward cooling sweep
shots.acceptance: the March-July precedent and the cooling Brent are both explicit; the 'others have not announced' card is a status, not a prediction
detail_choices: the toggle switches on/off to carry the on-again/off-again history
the falling arrow carries the cooling price without a second chart

shots.purpose: close: the question and the two actions
shots.start_state: brand block on the night sky
shots.end_state: Like/Subscribe pill with sheen, three recall chips, a small plane crossing
shots.primary_motion: question assembles, pill lands with a light sheen
shots.secondary_motion: sparkle on the pill, slow plane crossing, drift
shots.audio: two-note question motif and a sparkle; VO7 from 154.681 s
shots.acceptance: Like star and Subscribe play icons present and legible; final tail holds 2.2 s
detail_choices: recall chips repeat the three hardest facts so the last screen is still useful
no external links or handles beyond the two actions
